kind: Local implementation and automated-test evidence for cloud-read-only pending SpO2 reconciliation; no real-account execution
purpose: One explicit action reconciles all actually observed, nonconflicting pending SpO2 targets in the currently selected source plan. It never submits missing health records.

implementation.partial_history: Visible positive matches can reconcile; absent targets remain unqueried unless traversal explicitly completed.
implementation.conflict_priority: All observations are combined before classification. A tombstone, other/missing SID or content conflict in any returned view blocks that target even if another view matched.
implementation.local_commit: One DataStore.edit compares exact pending tokens and recovery metadata, preserves consumed budgets and latest business metadata, records observed fingerprints and removes only matching pending entries.
implementation.ownership: Observed matches cannot become newly owned uploads. Existing equal-content ownership/legacy provenance may be retained.
implementation.failure: CAS changes are distinct from local persistence failure. Neither is counted as reconciled. Authentication-shaped persistence exceptions do not trigger whole-operation auth replay.
implementation.count_partition: Each candidate has exactly one outcome. unresolved is candidate minus reconciled, not a global pending count.
implementation.account_and_selection_scope: Current account and source plan only. Unselected pending entries and unavailable source history are outside this action.

local_tests.disk_scope: Actual temporary PreferencesDataStore file, close coroutine scope and join before reopening. Not a process kill, device reboot, disk-corruption or power-loss experiment.

validation.adb_observation: No attached devices in the current cloud environment; this says nothing about whether the user PC has an attached phone.

limitations: This changes local reconciliation workflow; it is not evidence that any of the user 132 pending targets is visible to the new read path.
Cloud match proves observation of mapped fields at query time, not official Mi Fitness chart display or future retention.
Zero upload applies to this explicit reconciliation action; normal sync and explicit single recovery retain their existing separate behavior.
Rejected source material with unknown target attribution currently blocks reconciliation of that selected plan.
Missing after a completed endpoint traversal does not prove historical non-persistence or authorize automatic resubmission.
